name: revenge-c
description: Step 11.5 test (start at 06:00, three game days): a precious thing stolen. Kael takes Anselm's purse from the Tilted Cup while Anselm is out; Lena sees him do it, and tells Anselm by evening (the director only makes sure he finds out on day 1). Kael has a serious flaw, Anselm a proud streak and a long grudge. Watch Anselm: the grievance, the five-way choice (confront, get even, go to others, wait, let go), what he does about Kael, and Kael's lies when asked.

flaws.flaw: greedy: takes what he wants when nobody is looking

actions.worstSelf: Cornered, he lies smoothly and turns people against whoever accuses him.

flaws.flaw: proud: a slight to his house is a slight to him

actions.worstSelf: When someone wrongs him under his own roof, he wants them run out of the village.

actions.comment: Anselm fetches water; Lena comes in

actions.text: While the landlord was out at the well I slipped his purse off the shelf behind the counter and into my coat.
I saw the hooded stranger, Kael, slip Anselm's purse from the shelf behind the counter into his coat while Anselm was out.
My purse is gone from the shelf behind the counter — near all the coin I had. Lena told me she saw the stranger Kael slip it into his coat while I was at the well.

actions.reason: Kael stole my purse from behind my own counter.
